metric: mean per-question latency ratio to a fresh counterbalanced ordinary AR calibration
U_justification: Zero is the mathematical lower bound of a positive latency ratio; no reliable attainable ceiling estimate is available before method research
precision: BF16; no reduced BF16 GEMM reduction; no TF32; automatic SDPA; no reduced math attention
baseline_anchor_scope: Independent ordinary AR on the same private injected rows and seeds; fresh same-batch calibration; computed before final candidate normalization
counterbalance: Seeded three-role permutation per question, same RNG salt as development v2
visibility: Root-only assets, requests and per-sample outputs; never exposed by development API
